notes.title: New permanent price: $9.99!
notes.content:
Our cozy, award-winning VR puzzle game has just got a [b]new permanent price of $9.99! [/b]

There's never been a better time to explore the miniature worlds and help Grandfather find all the missing pets. The Curious Tale of the Stolen Pets is accessible and [b]fun for all kind of players[/b] regardless of age or gaming experience!

notes.title: Patch 1.01 now live
notes.content:
Pets require care & attention so we’re happy to inform you that [b]Patch 1.01[/b] for [b]The Curious Tale of the Stolen Pets[/b] is now live, adding a [b]reward for finding all the gold coins[/b], [b]improving overall game performance[/b] & more. 

Full patch notes below![list]
[*] Improved world rotation: No more risk experiencing the feeling of frame drops when rotating the worlds
[*] Added in-game reward and celebration when all coins have been found
[*] Added animation for pins on pin board in bedroom when new pets are found
[*] Added animated coins in bedroom jar when new coins have been found
[*] Optimized art and improved performance
[*] Adjusted priority of Grandfathers voice lines, so that it's less likely to cut off important lines
[*] Adjusted standard sound volume settings
[*] Improved collision on several objects
[/list]

notes.title: The Curious Tale wins 'Best Immersive Game' award at Raindance Film Festival!
notes.content:
Wohoo! Our upcoming interactive VR tale just won the '[b]Best Immersive Game[/b]' award at Raindance Film Festival! We faced some tough competition from great titles like No Man's Sky and Dr. Who: The Edge of Time but apparently managed to convince the jury with our [b]heart-warming, accessible and highly interactive game:-)[/b] 

The devs at our studio could not be any prouder to get this recognition, and we simply cannot wait to release The Curious Tale of the Stolen Pets for all VR gamers later this year.

If you haven't done so yet, [b]Wishlist it today![/b]
